state.title: API Center Management

alerts: Restart disabledSet `ALLOW_DEPLOYMENT_RESTARTS=true` in the server environment when you want the local console to run a rollout restart.

Secrets policyDo not put platform admin secrets, Descope client secrets, PayMongo keys, Google client secrets, Resend keys, Kafka credentials, or Redis URLs in browser-exposed variables. The platform admin secret belongs only as a server environment variable named `API_CENTER_PLATFORM_ADMIN_SECRET`.

Tribe token modeTribe M2M tokens are issued by API Center in internal JWT mode. Descope remains for human identity and future console login. Do not create one Descope app per tribe unless `AUTH_PROVIDER=descope` is explicitly enabled.
